about_intro: We are Actuators L.L.C., a decentralized digital institution building lightweight economic operating systems to unify and steer fragmented entrepreneurship ecosystems.
about_desc: We take pride in our team of engineers and experts who combine deep practical experience with modern academic knowledge. We don't just provide machines; we provide integrated solutions that increase efficiency, reduce waste, and improve production quality. From initial design to operation and maintenance, we are with you every step of the way.
vision_desc: To be the gold standard for industrial automation in the region, leading the transformation towards Industry 4.0 with smart and sustainable solutions.
mission_desc: To provide innovative and reliable automation technologies that enhance productivity and support the growth of our partners, while adhering to the highest standards of quality and occupational safety.
services_subtitle: Comprehensive engineering and technical solutions to enhance your industrial facility's efficiency
service_1_desc: We design and implement fully automated production lines, reducing human intervention and increasing accuracy and speed in industrial operations.
service_2_desc: Advanced programming for Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) to ensure smooth control and precise monitoring of all machine parts.
service_3_desc: We connect your entire factory to a centralized SCADA system for data collection and analysis, helping you make decisions based on real-time facts and figures.
service_4_desc: Integration of robotic arms into production lines for welding, painting, packaging, and material handling tasks, enhancing safety and speed.
service_5_desc: We provide preventive and corrective maintenance services to ensure your equipment operates at maximum efficiency, with necessary spare parts available.
service_6_desc: We offer technical consulting to develop your factory, and specialized training programs for your technical staff to enhance their ability to work with modern technology.

about_intro_text: Actuators is not just a conventional platform — it is a decentralized digital institution and a lightweight economic operating system, serving as a digital backbone to unify and steer fragmented entrepreneurship ecosystems.
about_problem_1_desc: A fragmented, high-risk informal economy with broken value chains and no trusted infrastructure.
about_problem_2_desc: Local founders isolated from international markets and diaspora capital due to opaque regulations and lack of transparency.
about_problem_3_desc: Over 200 startups operating with high agility, yet suffocated by the absence of a unified digital infrastructure.
about_sol_erp_desc: Transparent digital operational tools (task management, HR, sales) built for low-connectivity environments, giving companies solid institutional structure.
about_sol_diaspora_desc: A bridge connecting founders with the diaspora across the Mediterranean (Turkey, Greece, Italy) for transparent mentorship and investment flow.
about_sol_lms_desc: A platform integrating learning with professional execution to close knowledge gaps and compensate for the lack of institutional training for teams.
about_biz_free: Free for local youth to establish and access basic ERP modules, removing entry barriers.
about_biz_premium: Offered to donors and investors in exchange for ecosystem analytics and transparency reports.
about_imm_impact: Company survival rate and transition from survival to systems change (SDGs 4, 8, 10).
services_intro: Actuators provides standardized software infrastructure enabling entities to perform their operational and financial functions with precision and transparency across the network.
svc_dashboard_desc: Integrated management and real-time monitoring of ecosystem resources, with analytics tools and performance metrics to ensure operational continuity at peak efficiency.
svc_workflows_desc: Automated workflows to unify procedures from authentication to task completion in a systematic, error-proof manner.
svc_teams_desc: A centralized system for human resource management, role allocation, and permissions structured horizontally to fit distributed networks.
svc_verify_desc: Tamper-proof issuance and authentication of documents and certificates, building a trusted record of operational facts.
svc_layers_desc: Layered data ecosystem separating inputs, operational logic, and user interface to enable safe scaling.
svc_access_desc: Encrypted gateways connecting entities and securing the flow of capital, knowledge, and data between system nodes.
partners_desc: Active entities that joined the Actuators network and operate within the unified digital infrastructure.

problem_title: Syria's economy did not slow down. It collapsed.
problem_subtitle: 200+ startups are operating in one of the world's most fragile economies. Zero have a digital backbone. They use notebooks, WhatsApp, and Excel spreadsheets.
fail_bandwidth: Fixed broadband median — ranked #179 out of 181 countries. 70% rely on limited 3G.
fail_payment: E-commerce uses cash on delivery. Only 3 private payment gateways exist in the entire country.
fail_currency: Syrian pound lost vs USD since 2011. Fewer than 25% of adults hold a bank account.
fail_platform: No indigenous Syrian ERP or digital business management platform exists for Syrian SMEs.
arch_subtitle: A governance layer — the institutional infrastructure that fills the vacuum where functioning institutions used to be.
arch_layer1_desc: Real-time operational visibility — node grid, logs, core load monitoring. Web-based. Works at 4 Mbps — Syria's median fixed speed.
arch_layer2_desc: Project sequencing, team coordination, task tracking. Arabic-first, low-resource. The operational backbone your team has never had access to.
arch_layer3_desc: Full functionality in text-mode. Runs on any machine with any connection. When the web fails, your operations don't have to.
impact_title: Rewiring the system, not patching it.
impact_subtitle: The 5Rs change architecture — turning isolated founders into a coordinated economic engine that makes capital deployable and recovery measurable.
impact_roles_before: 200+ isolated founders with no shared infrastructure or governance norms
impact_roles_after: Networked ecosystem with shared documentation, coordination, and institutional-grade norms
impact_rel_before: Diaspora capital structurally blocked — no trust bridge or deal flow infrastructure exists
impact_rel_after: 6.1M diaspora connected to local builders via capital bridge built into the product layer
impact_rules_before: Paper ledgers, WhatsApp threads — no funder-accepted operational documentation standard
impact_rules_after: Digital trust + audit-grade documentation that institutional funders and INGOs require
impact_res_before: $216B reconstruction wave incoming with no digital absorption or deal flow infrastructure
impact_res_after: Verified, data-driven deal flow that makes capital deployable and impact measurable at scale
impact_results_before: 55 more years to GDP recovery at current trajectory — UNDP
impact_results_after: Coordinated, accelerating startup economy. The proof of concept for 1.5 billion people in fragile states.
impact_quote: 1.5 billion people live in fragile or conflict-affected states. Every one of them deserves digital infrastructure built for their reality. Syria is the proof of concept.
traction_stat1_desc: Organizers expected 50–60. Syria's first post-transition startup conference. Registrants from 15+ countries.
traction_stat2_desc: Web Dashboard + Rust Backend + Terminal UI — all shipped, all functional, all tested in real Syrian connectivity conditions.
traction_stat3_desc: Research-confirmed market void. No indigenous Syrian ERP exists. We are building into a confirmed vacuum.
milestone_done_1: Full MVP functional — web dashboard, Rust-based production server, Terminal UI
milestone_done_2: Low-bandwidth deployment validated at Syria's 4.05 Mbps median speed
milestone_done_3: Arabic-first interface — native design philosophy, not a translation layer
milestone_done_4: Audit-grade logging and operational documentation infrastructure operational
milestone_done_5: Early pilot with Syrian founders in real operational environments — use cases validated
milestone_next_1: Launch — 0 → 3,000 users, first institutional partnerships, company registration
milestone_next_2: Scale — 10,000 users, €50K–€120K revenue, first NGO contracts, Arabic NLP module
milestone_next_3: Expand — 2–3 MENA markets, break-even, template ready for post-conflict contexts globally
team_title: Built by people who understand the problem from the inside.
team_yahya_bio: Leads product vision, strategy, and business development at Actuators. Drives the mission of building Syria's first digital infrastructure layer for entrepreneurs — translating deep understanding of the Syrian economic context into a systems-level product.
team_mahmoud_bio: Designed and built Actuators' complete technical architecture: a Rust-based production server, a web dashboard optimised for low-bandwidth environments, and a full Terminal UI — engineered from first principles around Syria's connectivity constraints.
team_evidence: Two co-founders who shipped a working, multi-interface MVP with minimal resources — in exactly the environment they are building for.
model_subtitle: Not extracting value from Syrian entrepreneurs. Building the coordination layer that's free for those who need it most, monetized through those who benefit from the ecosystem it creates.
model_l1_desc: The asset that makes every other layer valuable. Free access creates the network effects and data infrastructure that institutional revenue depends on.
model_l2_desc: Advanced analytics, automation tools, diaspora investor modules. Subscriptions for teams ready to scale beyond the free tier operational core.
model_l3_desc: Cohort deployment, deal flow infrastructure, institutional reporting. Contracts with UNDP, GIZ, and diaspora investment networks accessing the ecosystem.
access_title: The window is open. Now is the time.
access_subtitle: Sanctions lifted mid-2025. $216B reconstruction incoming. 150% surge in new startups. The digital infrastructure layer must exist before the capital wave can land.
